title: Cron Builder
description: A visual cron expression builder: set minute/hour/day/month/weekday rules with buttons and chips, get a plain-English explanation, and preview the next 5 run times.

title: CSS Minifier
description: A byte-safe CSS minifier with a built-in verification pass: whitespace and (optionally) comments stripped only, no value rewriting or semicolon dropping, so the output always matches the input.

title: JS Minifier
description: A byte-safe JavaScript minifier with a built-in verification pass: comments, indentation, and blank lines stripped only — no renaming, no line-joining, no semicolon insertion, so ASI-sensitive code never changes behavior.

title: Regex Tester
description: A regex tester with live match highlighting (including nested capture groups), named groups broken out per match, and a clickable cheat sheet plus a library of common patterns.

title: CSS Visual Builder
description: Build clip-path, gradients (linear/radial/conic), and box-shadow with sliders and a live preview, then copy the generated CSS.

title: Text Diff Checker
description: Compare two blocks of text side-by-side with word- or character-level highlighting, ignore-case/whitespace options, collapsible unchanged lines, and one-click copy of the diff.
